title: Second review of the zodiac centres: only f70v2 carries a Voynich label inside the inner ring; elsewhere the centre writing is the month annotation alone
statement: Two independent checks of P-L4-004's finding. (1) Transcription structure (pinned ZL3b, line ids and unit codes only): on each of the twelve zodiac pages I looked for label lines after the last circular text line, i.e. inside the innermost ring. Only f70v2 has one, f70v2.33, and it carries no clock position (as a centre label would not). f70v1 has five label lines after its last circular line (f70v1.13-.17), but their ZL clock positions run 10:30, 00:00, 02:00, 05:00, 08:00 round the circle, so they are the inner ring's figure labels, not a centre label. f71r, f71v, f72r1, f72r2, f72r3, f72v1, f72v2, f72v3, f73r and f73v end on a circular text line, with no label inside it. (2) Scan, during blind picture annotation of seven centres (PIC-f70v2, f72r3, f72v1, f72v2, f72v3, f73r, f73v, fleet-opus): every centre shows the emblem (fish pair, two clawed animals, balance, blue-robed figure, four-legged animal with sprig, crossbowman, small four-legged animal with curled tail), mostly with one star; the only writing in each centre other than f70v2 is a single word beneath or beside the emblem in a hand and ink that differ from the ring text (darker on f72v2), which matches the Latin-script month annotations, and none has a transcription line of its own. On f70v2 the centre has two writings: a word between the fish and a Voynich word beside the upper star; the step identifies the latter as the one freestanding Voynich string, which fits f70v2.33 being the only centre label line. So no Voynich word is paired with a month annotation inside any zodiac centre; the one centre label (f70v2.33) stands beside a star, not beside the month word. I did not check the month words' spelling or hand date.
check: (1) reproducible from data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt: label lines after the last C line per zodiac folio, with their <!hh:mm> comments; (2) the cited PIC annotations' centre objects
